description: Share text into another app on the phone, like picking it in the share sheet: the text goes into that app's share action (for example a new note in Notes and Tasks). A title input that is not the share input gets `title`, or the first line of the text. Logged in app_activity as "share". Use share_targets to see which apps take shared text.

action.description: The share action, when the app has more than one (from share_targets)

from.description: The app the text is shared from, for the activity log

text.description: The text to share, up to 5000 characters

title.description: A title for the shared item (default: the first line of the text)

name: share
